text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Ines! Been a minute! Guess you're back to your old shift schedule.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahh, yeah, sorry! I hope this place wasn't too short-staffed without me?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: No wayyy! I'm happy you took that time off! I was worried you were literally going to work till you dropped.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Lemme know if you ever need me to cover a shift. Y'know, like, when you have practice and stuff. Oh, and any time you feel like working, you're welcome to my shifts too.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: I wanna do anything I can to help you out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "I've already adjusted your shift schedule for March. Make sure you rest up after the Osaka Hai."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Watching you run gives us hope, Ines."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: First my coworker and now my boss… Everyone's getting ahead of themselves trying to accommodate me.
choice_data_list: That's because they're dreaming through you.
That's because they're dreaming through you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha. C'mon, all this talk of hopes and dreams is a little much, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I do want to be able to pay them back for all their support, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, keep those expectations high! I'll take them with me to the track!
